name: Yasin Rahat
bio: Hi, I’m Rahat! I’m currently a senior at Tokyo International University, majoring in International Relations. I’ve applied to and been accepted by schools across the US, Europe, and Asia, so I bring firsthand experience with diverse application processes. Over the past three years, I’ve mentored more than 50 students, helping them craft strong, authentic applications to their dream universities. My extracurricular background includes debating, public speaking, creative writing, and leadership. Since I study IR, I’m especially passionate about supporting applications focused on social justice, politics, and nonprofit work. I’m well-versed in applications for the US, Europe, and Japan, and my mentoring style is friendly, personalized, and encouraging.
